sections.Profile:
Bally released Space Time , a four-player electro-mechanical game with a science fiction time-travel theme, in September 1972, and the two-player Time Zone in May 1973; Jim Patla designed both, with artwork by Christian Marche. Each has a lit 3D tunnel in the lower playfield and scores on mechanical reels, and Bally built 5,000 Space Time and 2,500 Time Zone machines.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1972–1973

- Type: Electro-Mechanical
